title: Nutty Norwegian Gorgonzola Pasta
description: A quick and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring gorgonzola dolce, pasta water emulsion, and a hint of wine, served on a hot stone plate. This satvik friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped walnuts to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the crumbly gorgonzola dolce until melted and smooth.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the fettuccine.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet with the gorgonzola sauce and toss to combine, adding some reserved pasta water if needed to achieve a creamy emulsion.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a hot stone plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
